g.text: Rastok — current Rust modules and crate boundary (registry: identity.md)
CLI assembly, source spans, named errors
tagged frontends, annotations and media types
strict JSON Schema, Avro, Arrow, OpenAPI
Process job / service, File, HTTP, WebSocket
registry / runtime / conformance; no DSL in Drivers
no clear credentials in semantic artifacts
bounded pure evaluation and exact readers
Graph wiring; Operator Dispatch; Connector Contract
journal / deadline / codec / loop_protocol / retry_protocol / instance_stop
unsealed original deadlines; no disk backend
SchemaPath; four standard annotations, typed metadata
compile-time dependency only in this direction
Module inventory and crate dependency; execution relationships are in view 03.
Core never imports compiler, Lab, browser, network libraries or OS APIs.
The shared Node/Executor model is semantic; no public Executor trait.
